global: A rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth fills a blue patterned bowl, topped with tender chashu slices and chopped green onions. The warm, rustic wooden table and soft lighting enhance the inviting, comforting appearance of this classic ramen dish.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain patterns and subtle texture with natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: Blue ceramic bowl with intricate floral pattern and raised rim, glossy finish, ornate detailing along the edge.
regions.soup: The broth with noodles appears creamy, pale yellow, and slightly textured, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slices show marbled texture with pinkish-brown meat, white fat, and slight char, cut into thick, round pieces.
